description: Player avatar system: avatar base, equipment fit and declaration, avatar pack, portraits, composer
deviation_notes: Owner decisions of 2026-10-01 recorded in the spec. Phase 3: the fit bounds rule became a show-through rule; pauldrons on the upper arms; shields on hand.L; base clips aim held items. Rollout: 138 equip blocks, 122 pass; 16 pieces moved to rework; the shield socket moved outward and lower; gloves and gauntlets need a closed-fist shape. 2026-10-02: all 12 fit reworks are ready (7.0 or more, fit ok); no catalog row is rework. Three displays moved onto y = 0 with their origins (cape, plate-armor, boots). 2026-10-04: capped hair done; hair styles moved to their own slot `hair` (a style stays under a hat); open pieces (circlet, crown, bandana) keep the full hair (`fullHair`). 2026-10-04 Phases 4-5: the portrait layers are a second script (scripts/avatar-portraits.ts); the pack uses WebP and Meshopt (no KTX2 transcoder in the kit) and keeps the tint mask PNG; hair layers are rendered per hair color; open head pieces have a layer per hair style; a new hair form `tucked` (cap only) for 6 pieces over the nape or cheeks; the explorer hat sits 1 cm higher; the 30-avatar bench ran on the 2012 machine (28.5 to 32.7 fps), not on a 2020 laptop.
